description: u--ith change #4. VERA/CATO probes for a threat-ratified mitigation MUST exercise the THREAT'S actual attack path and assert it is now blocked/throttled AND that legit low-rate traffic is NOT throttled — not merely exercise the artifact's happy path. 'Throttle trips at the 11th request' is artifact verification; 'the actual M2 attack is now capped, legit traffic unaffected' is threat verification (the missing half). Touches VERA role file + the runner skill. Pairs with C1 (the 'via probe P' clause).
title: Threat-anchored verification probes — exercise the attack path, not the happy path (u--ith #4)
